questions.Description: Write an Assembly Language Program for 16-bit addition and execute the same in the 8051 microcontroller kit.
Write an Assembly Language Program for 16-bit subtraction and execute the same in the 8051 microcontroller kit.
Write an Assembly Language Program for 8 bit multiplication and execute the same in the 8051 microcontroller Kit.
Write an Assembly Language Program for 8 bit division and execute the same in the 8051 microcontroller Kit.
Write and execute an Assembly Language Program for blinking LED with a time delay using time delay subroutine.
Write and execute an Assembly Language Program for transferring the status of input switches to the output LEDs after the counter counting 5number of pulses by using Counter 0 in Mode 1.
Interface a 4x4 matrix keypad with the 8051 microcontroller. Write an Assembly Language Program to detect key presses and display the pressed key on an LCD.
Interface a seven-segment LED display with the 8051 microcontroller. Write an Assembly Language Program to display digits from 0 to 9.
Interface a stepper motor with the 8051 microcontroller. Write an Assembly Language Program to rotate the motor in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions with a specified delay.
Interface a DC motor with the 8051 microcontroller. Write an Assembly Language Program to control a DC motor’s speed.
Interface an ADC with the 8051 microcontroller. Write an Assembly Language Program to convert an analog voltage input and display the digital equivalent on an LCD.
Write an Assembly Language Program to generate a PWM signal using the 8051 microcontroller. Execute the program and verify the waveform using an oscilloscope.
